text: God is our refuge and strength
The Lord is my shepherd I shall lack nothing
Be strong and courageous
Love one another as I have loved you
Cast all your worries on him because he cares for you
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me
Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light for my path
Trust in the Lord with all your heart
For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son
We are his workmanship created in Christ Jesus for good works
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart
Be strong and courageous Do not be afraid
Your word is a lamp to my feet
Give thanks to Yahweh for he is good
The joy of Yahweh is your strength
Let your light shine before men
Ask and it will be given to you
Come to me all you who labor and are heavily burdened
I am the way the truth and the life
Do to others what you want them to do to you
Love your neighbor as yourself
Be kind to one another tenderhearted forgiving each other
Rejoice always Pray without ceasing
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth
Yahweh is my light and my salvation Whom shall I fear
Create in me a clean heart O God
This is the day that Yahweh has made We will rejoice and be glad in it
Children obey your parents in the Lord for this is right
A soft answer turns away wrath
Whatever you do work heartily as for the Lord
The fruit of the Spirit is love joy peace patience kindness
Let no man despise your youth
Faith is assurance of things hoped for proof of things not seen
All have sinned and fall short of the glory of God
There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus
We know that all things work together for good for those who love God
Do not be conformed to this world but be transformed
Love is patient and is kind
Be anxious for nothing but in everything by prayer let your requests be made known
For by grace you have been saved through faith
He heals the broken in heart and binds up their wounds
Above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves
Be strong and of good courage
Yahweh is good to all
A friend loves at all times
Pray for those who persecute you
Seek first God's Kingdom and his righteousness
Let the little children come to me
My grace is sufficient for you
He who doesn't love doesn't know God for God is love
Give and it will be given to you
Blessed are the peacemakers
He must increase but I must decrease
Wait for Yahweh Be strong and let your heart take courage
